name: @penguinharness/rsi-opro
description: The OPRO RSI Toolkit: Large Language Models as Optimizers (Yang et al., 2023), run the way the paper does — the optimizer proposes new instructions from the history of scored instructions, every candidate is measured on the frozen Benchmark, and the best-scoring instruction is kept. Self-contained: it creates the Target's instruction slot, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.
